option_relations.rationale: The patient's presentation and laboratory findings do not strongly support acute coronary syndrome as the primary diagnosis.
ST-segment elevation due to myocardial metastasis from squamous cell carcinoma of the lung could be a manifestation of metastatic lung cancer to the heart.
Cardiac metastasis from lung cancer (intracardiac mass) directly corresponds to metastatic lung cancer to the heart.
Metastatic cardiac tumor (secondary to lung cancer) is another term for metastatic lung cancer to the heart.
